decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line builds directly on the firm's established natural-skincare formulation know-how and has its own website page, so management can read its early results well and refine it in-house.

A hyaluronic acid serum fits the firm's existing facial care competence and raw-material knowledge, so despite only a brief website mention, the small-batch in-house development lets the firm assimilate feedback and improve it rather than drop it.
A cleansing milk is a core, low-complexity complement to the firm's facial range that draws fully on its existing knowledge, so it is cheap to maintain and easy to adjust from customer advice.
